title: The end to the ever-over-flowing single hamper
text:
The end to the ever-over-flowing single hamper. Bought 2, and it was not overkill. 2 kids, 2 adults, 8 hampers. Overly organized, but happy.
Not sure about the longevity of the hardware, but they are cheap enough that as long as they last a year I'm happy.
